desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on fresh Ukrainian drone strikes hitting Russian energy and transport infrastructure in the rear, alongside signs of renewed diplomatic activity around Abu Dhabi talks. The single most important thread is confirmation of major damage to the Samara oil pumping station and a key Rostov bridge, both tied to ongoing deep-strike campaigns.

## MAIN THREADS
### Samara oil facility strikes
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2119484141544886370) posted Radio Svoboda satellite imagery showing up to 10 fuel tanks destroyed or still burning after five Ukrainian strikes in October–November.
- Multiple accounts note the facility remains a high-value target for Ukraine’s long-range drone campaign.

### Rostov bridge and substation hits
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2119463691821154419) and its quoted earlier post detail FP-2 drone footage striking the Mius River bridge on the P-280 highway, with the governor downplaying it as “debris”; the same account reports parallel substation damage.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2119463035261669627) links the bridge strike to disrupted logistics toward occupied Crimea.

### Ukraine delegation to Abu Dhabi
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2119474844731404698) cites an RBC-Ukraine source naming the full delegation (Umerov, Budanov, Arakhamia, Kyslytsya, Skibitskyi) for upcoming talks.

### CASEVAC drone development
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2119463035261669627) reports SkyFall’s new CASEVAC drones successfully evacuating wounded troops in three missions.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2119477142450733486) reports air-defense activation in Nariman, Qeshm, Iran (unconfirmed).  
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2119477638817345759) later labels a related alert a “false alarm” (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching for follow-on Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy nodes and any public readout from the Abu Dhabi delegation. ISW’s Russia-team hiring push signals sustained analytical focus on the theater.
